piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS, SUKRUT SMILES
piece.big_picture: Haaland got the armband from 14 managers and gave back 2 points. Sukrut was 8 clear before this week and is now 18 ahead of Aditya Dalal. Dalal was one of the Haaland captains. The title race just got a lot less tense.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Anuj swapped Giles, Wissa and João Pedro for Robertson, N.Jackson and Evanilson. The swap returned 19 points. 3 in, 3 out, and the gamble landed. Brave and busy, and it worked.
piece.one_to_watch: Title race first: Sukrut leads Aditya Dalal by 18. Further down, Anuj and Aryan are 8 apart at the Gold spots line. Anuj's swaps paid this week, so Aryan has work to do.

winners.name: Aditya Dharap
winners.verdict: Backed Konsa alone, and it paid 16 points. Bench Boost added nothing, but the lone captain pick was nerve, not luck.

winners.name: Arya
winners.verdict: Climbed from 13th to 8th in one week. Quietly the best mover in the league.

winners.name: Sukrut
winners.verdict: Stayed top and stretched the lead while the armband crowd stumbled. Dalal will be checking the gap.

ratings.l: Only manager to back Konsa as captain, and it paid. Pure nerve, rewarded.
